messages:
marta: Quick design review thread — compact charts for the dashboard. Question: on narrow widths should the legend collapse into an overlay menu instead of truncating text? I attached a small mock in the doc link (see pinned). devin: +1 to overlay. Truncation hides the series meaning. Maybe a tiny "Show legend" icon in the top-right of the card? :thumbsup: sam: Overlay is good. Accessibility note: legend items must be keyboard-focusable and have clear aria labels. Example snippet we can use: ```
  • CPU
    • ``` lee: Axis units: suggestion to default to 'auto' (choose best unit like ms / s) and expose a per-chart unit toggle in the header. On mobile the toggle should be moved into the overflow menu. audrey: Smoothing: I think default should be OFF. People expect to see raw points unless it's explicitly a trend/chart type. Provide an opt-in smoothing toggle per series: `smoothing: gaussian(2)` or `moving_average(5)`. :sparkles: devin: Outliers handling: two ideas — dim points outside 3*IQR and add "Show outliers" checkbox, or cap extremes to the 99.5th percentile and render capped points with dotted outline. Both keep the main shape readable. marta: UX nit — legend color swatches currently fail contrast on the light background (green looks too light). Can we standardize to colors that meet 4.5:1 for small text, or add a bold border on the swatch? design-bot: Added card to the design board: #chart-compact-legend, tags: [a11y, mobile, chart-ux]. sam: I'll mock a compact overlay (keyboard + screenreader flow) and post by EOD. Will include sample HTML markup and tabindex order. :eyes: devin: Implementation question — do we need a feature flag for the overlay and per-series smoothing toggles? @lee can you advise on rollout? lee: Yep, I can add a feature flag: `chart.compactLegend` and `chart.seriesSmoothing`. Backend changes minimal (flags + small prefs store). ETA Wed. marta: Great, thanks. Putting this on next iteration PR — will include the contrast tokens, aria markup, and the unit toggle placement. devin: tiny follow-up — make sure hover tooltips still show full unit names (e.g., "ms (p95)"), not abbreviations — saved a few support tickets. audrey: Also add an optional small-dot mode for density charts (less point occlusion) and an explicit legend entry for clipped/outlier points. marta: Awesome, team — syncing up after mocks come in. :thumbsup:
